tagline: Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
title: What Is MCP?
disclosure: Fictional teaching scenario based on researched conditions

onScreen.text: An AI model can reason, write and analyze.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: An AI model can reason, write, and analyze. But without access to your business tools, it’s limited in the real world.

onScreen.text: MCP is a standard way for AI to connect with tools.
onScreen.emphasis: Think of it as a universal adapter.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: That’s where MCP, or Model Context Protocol, comes in. It’s a standard way for AI systems to securely connect with external tools and information.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Think of MCP as a universal adapter for AI. Through MCP, an AI agent can find documents, check customer records, query databases, or schedule meetings—depending on the permissions it has.
